name: Sunflare
look: a great sunflower with flame-shaped orange-red petals, a dark seed-head face with closed happy eyes, a yellow ring of seeds, a hooked green stem, ember-tipped leaves and little green feet
entry: On the hottest days of summer its petals burst into flame. It turns its burning face to follow the sun across the sky and stores so much heat that it glows all through the night.
how: Use a Fire Stone on a Sunflora. It learns Heat Wave when it evolves.
